title: Lock hierarchical burn-graph delivery contracts
goal: Use the current guarded CLI to lock the parent-child graph, machine Gate, Wait, template, control-plane, and dogfood contracts before runtime implementation.

prompt.objective: Revise the formal product promise and draft complete user paths for hierarchical execution, machine Gate, durable Wait, templates, and measurable dogfood.
instructions: Role: product contract owner for this bounded node; the main Codex remains project owner.
Keep burn-graph provider-neutral: the calling AI executes prompts and burn-graph executes only registered machine checks.
Describe static and dynamic child graphs, ordinary done-based attachment, folded overview with bounded expansion, and local-only state.
Record this user request as feedback and keep each fact in one Product Private owner.
doneWhen: Product boundaries and non-goals are unambiguous.
Draft user paths include visible normal, failure, restart, repair, and completion results.
The proposed paths preserve the existing v1 CLI loop and lightweight package.

prompt.objective: Extend the existing design system and Product Preview with production-faithful parent-child overview, folded and expanded diagrams, Gate, Wait, failure, and recovery states.
instructions: Role: design-system and Product Preview owner for this bounded node.
Reuse GraphOverviewRegion and GraphDetailRegion; do not create a second visual system or graph editor.
Keep the Viewer read-only and CLI-first.
Capture deterministic wide and narrow screenshots and visually inspect them.
doneWhen: The Preview visibly distinguishes root, parent, child, Gate, Wait, Running, Failed, and aggregate progress.
Folded overview is readable and expanded hierarchy remains bounded.
Wide and narrow screenshots have no clipping, illegible status, or conflicting visual language.

prompt.objective: Define the backward-compatible GraphSpec v2, SQLite hierarchy, cross-run transitions, safe Gate process boundary, Wait signal semantics, resource locks, and CLI additions.
instructions: Role: architecture and contract owner for this bounded node.
Use static inspection and minimal non-production PoCs only; do not implement the runtime.
Preserve v1 GraphSpecs, historical Runs, opaque handles, idempotency, bounded output, and exact-process cleanup.
Resolve transaction, failure, pause, cancel, scheduling, hierarchy limit, and migration behavior.
doneWhen: The public data and CLI contracts are decision-complete.
Cross-run atomicity and recovery behavior have one deterministic rule.
No command can execute through a shell or stop an unowned process.
Migration and compatibility Gates are executable.

prompt.objective: Create a reproducible observational baseline from the nine completed historical Runs and dev.4 Evidence for later hierarchy dogfood comparison.
instructions: Role: evaluation evidence owner for this bounded node.
Use only bounded CLI snapshots and committed Evidence; keep raw JSON under ignored .agent-runtime.
Record what the old runtime can and cannot measure rather than inventing missing metrics.
Define beneficial, neutral, and harmful verdict rules before the new runtime exists.
doneWhen: Historical Run, node, revision, attempt, and event facts are reproducible.
The report labels the comparison observational rather than causal.
Final verdict thresholds include recovery, duplicate work, known-bad Gate detection, quality, and control overhead.

prompt.objective: Converge the product paths, visible Preview, architecture, historical baseline, milestones, versions, vertical slices, and executable version plans.
instructions: Role: formal delivery contract owner for this bounded node.
Write regional BDD with observable normal, concurrency, failure, recovery, safety, migration, and performance outcomes.
Use M05 dev.5, M06 dev.6, M07 dev.7, and M08 rc.1 with vertical S08 onward slices.
Update project.json atomically and preserve one fact owner between Graph runtime and project governance.
doneWhen: Every new user path has BDD, slice, milestone, version, Preview, and Done When references.
Dependencies permit safe parallel work without duplicate file ownership.
The only pre-implementation blocker is explicit user confirmation of Preview, User Paths, and BDD.

prompt.objective: Choose pass only when Product Preview, User Paths, BDD, architecture, milestones, slices, plans, and baseline are coherent and ready for user lock.
instructions: Role: read-only contract reviewer for this bounded node.
Inspect actual screenshots, builds, path references, JSON schemas, and repository diffs.
Route repair for any ambiguity, missing recovery, unsafe process boundary, duplicate source of truth, or unverifiable Done When.
doneWhen: The selected route cites concrete evidence and leaves no hidden implementation decision.
